architectural_invariants.statement: Fresh sessions recover from durable project state, not transcript memory.
A claim is not proof until the relevant evidence authority verifies it.
User intent cannot silently widen tools, permissions, or data boundaries.
A task is bounded work; a capability identity is not a task and does not become an agent by naming.
A role/profile supplies capability context and does not itself execute work.
Goal PASS, candidate verification, release readiness, and promoted authority are separate states.
A worker result is proposed output until the parent verifies it against authoritative evidence.
Durable state and status projection do not grant background execution or scheduler behavior.
Design-intelligence faculties are metadata and do not expand canonical capability identities.
P2P remains the only router/orchestrator; no second router or executor is introduced.
Unsupported host identity or live delegation remains UNKNOWN/NOT_CERTIFIED.
A promoted baseline changes only through the approved release and lineage workflow.
Harness, provider, model, protocol, and workspace are distinct composition dimensions; the identity of one is never a proxy for the capability or auth state of another.
Transport or API compatibility never implies behavioral certification; certification requires the live-certification path, never a declaration.
